cell.capacity_ah: 60.9 * cathode_loading / 22.0 - 0.012 * max(0, moisture_ppm - 200) - 0.35 * max(0, 245 - fill_g) + noise(0.22)
cell.k_value_mv_day: 0.07 + 0.0004 * max(0, moisture_ppm - 200) + noise(0.015), plus 0.4 to 3.0 when a micro-short forms
cell.grade: A: capacity >= 60.0, DCIR <= 0.90, K <= 0.20; B: capacity >= 58.8, DCIR <= 0.95, K <= 0.25; else NG

notes: The cell's end-of-line results from its genealogy (simulate.py)
